# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Do not open up a GitHub issue if the bug is a security vulnerability**.
Instead, send us email: webmaster@luuppi.fi or create a draft security advisory via
https://github.com/luuppiry/luuppi-next/security/advisories and click 'Report a vulnerability'

## Open a draft security advisory

- in most cases, set CVE identifier as not applicable.
- for severity you can use the Low, Moderate, High and Critical presets.
- severity does not need to be perfect and you don't need to know what CVSS is, a maintainer will clean it up.
